items.title: 31.5 Petroleum ki fractional distillation aur refining (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of fractional distillation (PDF 225-226).

blocks.text: Kacha tel hydrocarbons ka pecheeda amezah hai jise saada aur mufeed hydrocarbons mein alag karna zaruri hai. Yeh tabai taur par fractional distillation se hota hai, jo hydrocarbons ke boiling points ke farq par munhasir hai. Kacha tel bhatti (furnace) mein bhaap banne tak garam kiya jata hai, aur bhaap fractionating column mein jati hai, aik ooncha minar jis mein oopar jate hue darja hararat ahista ahista girta hai. Bhaap oopar uthte hue ajza apne boiling points ke mutabiq mukhtalif oonchaiyon par condense hote hain: zyada boiling point wale bhari hydrocarbons neeche ke qareeb, aur kam boiling point wale halke hydrocarbons zyada oopar tak jate hain.

blocks.alt: Fractionating column, neeche sab se garam, furnace se garam bhaap (hot vaporized crude oil) aati hai; darja hararat ki patti oopar <20 C se neeche >370 C tak, aur chhe nikaas fractions ke khanon tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.6: Kache tel ki fractional distillation se mufeed hydrocarbons (kitab ki Figure 31.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Lamba fractionating column, neeche sab se garam (surkh) aur oopar sab se thanda (halka peela), andar trays aur oopar jaate neele teer. Baen: darja hararat ki patti, oopar 20 C se kam aur neeche 370 C se zyada; crude oil input furnace se guzar kar garam bhaap (hot vaporized crude oil) ban kar column mein jata hai. Chhe nikaas khanon tak: top of the column, Gases (e.g., LPG) <25 C, khana pakana aur garmi; Gasoline (petrol) C8H18, <40 C - 200 C; Kerosene C10H22, 150-275 C, jet fuel, lamps; Diesel C14-C19, 250-350 C; Lubricating oils C15-C20, 300-370 C; Residue (bitumen) C20+, >370 C.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Column neeche sab se garam aur oopar sab se thanda hai. Bhaap oopar charhti hai; har hydrocarbon us tray par maye (liquid) ban jata hai jahan darja hararat us ke boiling point se kam ho. Is liye chhote, halke molecules (gases, petrol) oopar se aur bare, bhari molecules (lubricating oils, bitumen) neeche se nikalte hain. Kitab ki figure kerosene ke neeche 'C10H14' chhapti hai, jo alkane ka formula nahi; khaake mein 10 carbon wala alkane C10H22 (decane) likha gaya hai (kerosene taqreeban C10 se C16 ke hydrocarbons ka amezah hai).

blocks.caption: Kache tel ke fractions (Figure 31.6 se)
rows: 40 C se neeche ta 200 C chhapa

blocks.title: Chhape size jaanchein
blocks.text: Figure 31.6 kerosene par 'C10H14' likhti hai, jo alkane ka formula nahi (10 carbon wala alkane C10H22 hai); kerosene taqreeban C10 se C16 ke hydrocarbons ka amezah hai. Lubricating oils C15-C20 chhape hain, jo diesel se milte hain; doosre hawale bare molecules, taqreeban C20 se C50, dete hain. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.
Fractional distillation ahem hai kyunke yeh sanat, gharelu aur naql-o-hamal ke kaamon ke liye petrochemicals faraham karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar fossil fuels qabil-e-tajdeed nahi, to duniya bhar mein ab bhi itne zyada kyun use hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh zyada energy density wale bohat kaarguzar zaraye hain, aasani se dastyab hain, aur gariyan, bijli ghar aur sanatein inhein use karne ke liye bani hain; yeh petrochemicals ka kacha maal bhi dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya XRD se kisi liquid ki banawat maloom ki ja sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Usi tarah nahi: XRD crystal mein atoms ki ba-qaida, dohrai jane wali tarteeb par munhasir hai. Liquid mein aisi door tak tarteeb nahi, is liye yeh sirf phaile hue dhundle patterns deta hai; aam taur par maddah pehle crystal banaya jata hai.

items: Fractional distillation kache tel ko boiling point se alag karti.
Column neeche sab se garam, oopar sab se thanda.
Fractions: gases, gasoline, kerosene, diesel, lubricating oils, bitumen.
